model: Three Oaks Bakery: a monthly box?

N1.comment: Cap at two pauses a year or packing gets unpredictable.

N3.comment: Saturday works for the counter team.

N10.comment: Hold unpaid boxes. We cannot chase payments.

N11.comment: Customers ask about gluten-free every week.

notes.text: Collection only might lose the two villages we deliver bread to on Fridays.
notes.author: Manager

replies.view: The Friday village round is how some older regulars get bread at all. A box they cannot collect will feel like it is not for them.
replies.question: Could the Friday van carry boxes for the two villages, so they are not left out?
replies.author: AI assistant

replies.view: The van already runs on Fridays, so a few boxes add little cost. A full delivery option would not pay.
replies.question: How many village boxes would make the van stop worth it?
replies.author: AI assistant

replies.view: Keeping the pilot simple matters more than covering everyone in the first eight weeks.
replies.question: Do we add the villages in the pilot, or say clearly they come later?
replies.author: AI assistant
